name: robots/nobleo__sick_scan2
title: SICK scan2 ROS 2 laser scanner
intro: SICK scan2 ROS 2 laser scanner, adapted from nobleo/sick_scan2. It reads `read_laser_scan`. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/nobleo__sick_scan2 --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/nobleo__sick_scan2 --backend fake --mcp
